response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with nearly two decades of software experience, but the role requires deep specialization in SoC/IP modeling, hardware performance architecture, and AI accelerator design. There is no evidence of hardware architecture, GPU/SIMD work, deep-learning workload optimization, or hardware-software co-design experience. The overlap is limited to some low-latency systems programming (DLang, C/C++), which falls well short of principal-level hardware performance architecture expertise.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (18+ years) exceeding the years-of-experience requirement
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching in DLang at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source contributions demonstrating technical depth
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, performance architecture, or hardware design experience whatsoever
No GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning training/inference optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, not hardware or performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DL workload optimization background
